# PDF.js

Upstream `pdfjs-dist` 6.5.438 from the npm registry. The two modules are the unchanged upstream distribution files from `build/`. The WebAssembly decoders and notices are from `wasm/`. The Adobe CNS1 Unicode map and its notice are from `cmaps/`.

PDF pages are fetched in the student's browser from the publisher origin when requested. This distribution contains no textbook files.
